title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin self-custody discussions are surging as hashrate holds at 941.7 EH/s and the network absorbs the latest supply shock from this halving cycle. Marty Bent has noted the Fed remains boxed in on rates, a limit already baked into Bitcoin's design. Andreas Antonopoulos has flagged this cycle as distinct because prior halvings have hardened the protocol against shocks.

Price sits at $62,966, up 0.4 percent, with Fear & Greed at 34. Mempool shows 76,230 transactions and a 1 sat/vB floor. Block
